ports.name: clk_i
ports.functionality: Provides the clock edge used by all clocked processes. It sequences updates to synchronization registers, TAP control state, data registers and the DMI controller so the entity responds to JTAG/DMI events.
ports.evidence: rising_edge(clk_i) used in processes tap_synchronizer, tap_control, update_trigger, reg_access, dmi_controller

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.functionality: Provides asynchronous reset behavior for clocked processes. When low it forces many registers to defined reset values, overriding normal updates and initializing TAP/DMI state.
ports.evidence: if (rstn_i = '0') then ... reset branches in multiple clocked processes

ports.name: jtag_tck_i
ports.functionality: Is sampled into the three-stage synchronizer shift register tap_sync.tck_ff on clk_i, supplying the sampled pattern that forms tck_rising/tck_falling edge signals used by the TAP controller.
ports.evidence: tap_sync.tck_ff <= tap_sync.tck_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tck_i in tap_synchronizer process

ports.name: jtag_tdi_i
ports.functionality: Is sampled into the three-stage synchronizer tap_sync.tdi_ff on clk_i; the synchronized tap_sync.tdi bit is later used to shift IR/DR values into internal TAP registers during shift states.
role: provides serial data for register shifts
ports.evidence: tap_sync.tdi_ff <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tdi_i in tap_synchronizer process

ports.name: jtag_tdo_o
ports.functionality: Drives the JTAG TDO line from the selected internal register bit or bypass bit. It is assigned in the reg_access clocked process on tck falling and initialized at reset.
ports.evidence: jtag_tdo_o <= ... assignments inside reg_access process (reset and on tap_sync.tck_falling condition)

ports.name: jtag_tms_i
ports.functionality: Is sampled into the three-stage synchronizer tap_sync.tms_ff on clk_i; the synchronized tap_sync.tms bit is used to control TAP state transitions in the TAP controller case logic.
ports.evidence: tap_sync.tms_ff <= tap_sync.tms_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tms_i in tap_synchronizer process

ports.name: dmi_req_o
ports.functionality: Provides the outgoing DMI request record to the external DMI target. Its individual fields are driven from the internal dmi_ctrl registers to start DMI read/write operations.
ports.evidence: dmi_req_o.op/data/addr <= dmi_ctrl.op/wdata/addr concurrent assignments at architecture end

ports.name: dmi_req_o.addr
ports.functionality: Conveys the 7-bit address for a DMI operation to the external DMI target. It is driven directly from dmi_ctrl.addr which is set when a DR capture/shift requests a DMI transaction.

ports.name: dmi_req_o.op
ports.functionality: Conveys the DMI operation code (read/write/nop) to the external target. It directly reflects the internal dmi_ctrl.op register which is set when a DR write/read is captured.

ports.name: dmi_req_o.data
ports.functionality: Carries the 32-bit write data for DMI write requests to the external target. It is driven directly from dmi_ctrl.wdata, which is sourced from the tapped DR value when a write is requested.

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i
ports.functionality: Receives the response record from the external DMI target. Its fields are sampled into internal dmi_ctrl registers to clear busy and to capture read data and ack status.
role: supplies DMI response data and ack
ports.evidence: dmi_ctrl.rdata <= dmi_rsp_i.data and if (dmi_rsp_i.ack = '1') then dmi_ctrl.busy <= '0' in dmi_controller

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i.data
ports.functionality: Supplies the 32-bit read data from the external DMI target; when busied it is captured into dmi_ctrl.rdata so the DR can present read results after completion.

ports.name: dmi_rsp_i.ack
ports.functionality: Indicates completion of an outstanding DMI transfer. When asserted the controller clears dmi_ctrl.busy, enabling new transactions; the ack is tested inside the DMI controller process.

signals.name: tap_sync
signals.function: container for synchronized JTAG pins and flags
signals.functionality: Aggregates the three-stage shift registers for jtag inputs and the derived edge/bit flags (tck_rising, tck_falling, tdi, tms). Its fields are produced by the synchronizer and consumed by TAP logic.
role: carries sampled inputs and edge flags
signals.evidence: tap_sync record declared and individual fields assigned/used throughout synchronizer and TAP logic

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_ff
signals.functionality: Captures jtag_tck_i each clk_i into a 3-bit shift register (LSB = newest). Its two top bits are examined to produce tck_rising/tck_falling edge pulses used by the TAP controller.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tck_ff <= tap_sync.tck_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tck_i in tap_synchronizer; tck_rising/falling computed from tck_ff(2 downto 1)

signals.name: tap_sync.tdi_ff
signals.functionality: Samples jtag_tdi_i into a 3-bit register each clk_i; its most-significant bit is exported as tap_sync.tdi for use when shifting IR/DR data into internal registers.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tdi_ff <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tdi_i; tap_sync.tdi <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(2)

signals.name: tap_sync.tms_ff
signals.functionality: Samples jtag_tms_i across clock cycles into a 3-bit register; the MSB is exposed as tap_sync.tms and controls TAP state transitions in the control state machine.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tms_ff <= tap_sync.tms_ff(1 downto 0) & jtag_tms_i; tap_sync.tms <= tap_sync.tms_ff(2)

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_rising
signals.function: rising-edge pulse detector for sampled TCK
signals.functionality: Is asserted when the two newest samples in tap_sync.tck_ff equal "01", indicating a JTAG TCK rising edge. It gates TAP state updates and register shift operations.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tck_rising <= '1' when (tap_sync.tck_ff(2 downto 1) = "01") else '0'; used in tap_control and reg_access conditions

signals.name: tap_sync.tck_falling
signals.function: falling-edge pulse detector for sampled TCK
signals.functionality: Is asserted when the two newest samples in tap_sync.tck_ff equal "10", indicating a JTAG TCK falling edge. It is used to time the TDO output updates from selected register bits.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tck_falling <= '1' when (tap_sync.tck_ff(2 downto 1) = "10") else '0'; used in reg_access if (tap_sync.tck_falling = '1')

signals.name: tap_sync.tdi
signals.functionality: Carries the most-significant bit of tap_sync.tdi_ff as the synchronized serial data bit. It is used as the input bit when shifting data into IR/DR registers during shift states.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tdi <= tap_sync.tdi_ff(2); tap_sync.tdi used on RHS of shifts in reg_access

signals.name: tap_sync.tms
signals.functionality: Exposes the synchronized TMS level (MSB of tms_ff) to the TAP control FSM; the TMS value determines state transitions inside the case statement when sampled on tck rising.
signals.evidence: tap_sync.tms <= tap_sync.tms_ff(2); tap_control tests tap_sync.tms in case branches

signals.name: tap_ctrl_state
signals.functionality: Holds the current TAP state. It is updated on sampled TCK rising edges according to tap_sync.tms and the current state, and its value gates register capture/shift actions and update-trigger generation.
signals.evidence: tap_ctrl_state <= ... updated in tap_control process when tap_sync.tck_rising='1'; other processes test tap_ctrl_state to control captures/shifts

signals.name: tap_reg
signals.functionality: Aggregates instruction register, bypass bit, IDCODE, DTMCS and DMI shift/capture storage. Individual fields are updated in reg_access (clocked) or derived combinationally via *_nxt signals.
signals.evidence: tap_reg record declared; fields assigned in reg_access and via concurrent assignments

signals.name: tap_reg.ireg
signals.functionality: Holds the current IR value. It is loaded with the IDCODE instruction on reset/IR_CAPTURE or shifted serially during IR_SHIFT from tap_sync.tdi; its value selects which DR is active.
signals.evidence: tap_reg.ireg loaded with addr_idcode_c on LOGIC_RESET/IR_CAPTURE and shifted with tap_sync.tdi in IR_SHIFT; used as case selector in reg_access and compared in dmi_controller

signals.name: tap_reg.bypass
signals.functionality: Single-bit bypass storage used when no DR is selected. It is reset to '0' and in DR_SHIFT can be loaded from the serial tap_sync.tdi; its value is presented on TDO when others DRs are not selected.
role: provides TDO when no DR selected
signals.evidence: tap_reg.bypass set in reset and assigned tap_sync.tdi in DR_SHIFT/others; used in reg_access when others => jtag_tdo_o <= tap_reg.bypass

signals.name: tap_reg.idcode
signals.functionality: Holds the device ID code. It is loaded from the generic IDCODE parts on DR_CAPTURE for the IDCODE instruction and shifted serially during DR_SHIFT using the synchronized TDI bit for bit input; its LSB drives TDO during shifts.
signals.evidence: tap_reg.idcode <= IDCODE_VERSION & IDCODE_PARTID & IDCODE_MANID & '1' in DR_CAPTURE; shifted with tap_sync.tdi in DR_SHIFT; used for jtag_tdo_o

signals.name: tap_reg.dtmcs
signals.functionality: Holds the current DTM control/status register value. It is updated from dtmcs_nxt in DR_CAPTURE and can be shifted in DR_SHIFT; its bit 16/17 are sampled by DMI controller when an update is triggered.
role: provides DTM fields to DMI controller
signals.evidence: tap_reg.dtmcs <= tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt in DR_CAPTURE; shifted in DR_SHIFT; tap_reg.dtmcs(16/17) read by dmi_controller when dr_trigger.valid and ireg = addr_dtmcs_c

signals.name: tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt
signals.functionality: Combinationally assembles the next DTMCS contents from constants, dmi_ctrl flags and tap_reg.dmi_nxt fields. This value is captured into tap_reg.dtmcs during DR_CAPTURE.
signals.evidence: concurrent assignments to tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt bits from dmi_ctrl and tap_reg.dmi_nxt, then used in reg_access DR_CAPTURE to update tap_reg.dtmcs

signals.name: tap_reg.dmi
signals.functionality: Holds the concatenated DMI transaction fields (addr, rdata, err) assembled by captures or shifted during DR_SHIFT. Portions are sampled into the DMI controller when an update trigger requests a transaction.
signals.evidence: tap_reg.dmi_nxt assigned from dmi_ctrl; tap_reg.dmi <= tap_reg.dmi_nxt in DR_CAPTURE; dmi_controller reads tap_reg.dmi(40 downto 34), (33 downto 02), (1 downto 0)

signals.name: tap_reg.dmi_nxt
signals.functionality: Combinationally constructs the next DMI DR contents from dmi_ctrl.addr, dmi_ctrl.rdata and replicated dmi_ctrl.err. It is captured into tap_reg.dmi during DR_CAPTURE.
signals.evidence: tap_reg.dmi_nxt <= dmi_ctrl.addr & dmi_ctrl.rdata & replicate_f(dmi_ctrl.err, 2)

signals.name: dr_trigger
signals.function: update-trigger shift register and valid flag
signals.functionality: Aggregates a two-bit shift register that detects a DR_UPDATE event (dr_trigger.sreg) and computes dr_trigger.valid when the pattern '01' appears. The valid flag gates DMI controller actions to start/process transactions.
signals.evidence: dr_trigger.sreg updated in update_trigger process; dr_trigger.valid <= '1' when sreg = "01"; used in dmi_controller conditions

signals.name: dr_trigger.sreg
signals.functionality: Shifts in a '1' when tap_ctrl_state = DR_UPDATE at clock edge, creating a two-cycle pattern that the valid flag detects. sreg(1) follows sreg(0) to create the '01' detection window.
signals.evidence: update_trigger sets dr_trigger.sreg(0) based on (tap_ctrl_state = DR_UPDATE) and shifts sreg(1) <= sreg(0)

signals.name: dr_trigger.valid
signals.functionality: Combinationally indicates a one-cycle valid event when dr_trigger.sreg equals '01'. This valid signal is used extensively to gate DTMCS updates and to start/qualify DMI transactions in the DMI controller.
signals.evidence: dr_trigger.valid <= '1' when (dr_trigger.sreg = "01") else '0'; dmi_controller checks dr_trigger.valid in multiple conditions

signals.name: dmi_ctrl
signals.functionality: Aggregates DMI controller status and transaction fields (busy, op, resets, err, rdata, wdata, addr). The fields are updated in a clocked process and drive tap_reg.dmi_nxt and the exported dmi_req_o.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl record declared; fields assigned in dmi_controller and used to form tap_reg.dmi_nxt and dmi_req_o

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.busy
signals.functionality: Indicates an outstanding DMI transaction. It is set when a new read/write DR is captured and cleared on dmi_rsp_i.ack; it gates start conditions and affects error behavior.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.busy set to '1' when tap_reg.dmi(1 downto 0) indicates rd/wr and dr_trigger.valid, cleared when dmi_rsp_i.ack='1' in dmi_controller

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.op
signals.functionality: Holds the operation code presented to the DMI target (nop/rd/wr). It is defaulted to nop each cycle and overwritten with the captured tap_reg.dmi opcode when a transaction starts; exported via dmi_req_o.op.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.op <= dmi_req_nop_c; possibly overwritten with tap_reg.dmi(1 downto 0) when starting transaction; dmi_req_o.op <= dmi_ctrl.op

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset
signals.functionality: Latches the dmihardreset control bit; it is set from tap_reg.dtmcs when an update is triggered for DTMCS and otherwise cleared when controller is idle. It affects error clearing and DTMCS reporting.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset <= tap_reg.dtmcs(17) when dr_trigger.valid and tap_reg.ireg = addr_dtmcs_c in dmi_controller; tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt(17) <= dmi_ctrl.dmihardreset

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.dmireset
signals.functionality: Latches the dmireset control bit from DTMCS on DR_UPDATE and is otherwise cleared when controller idle. When set it causes error clearing and is reflected into DTMCS reporting.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.dmireset <= tap_reg.dtmcs(16) when dr_trigger.valid and tap_reg.ireg = addr_dtmcs_c in dmi_controller; tap_reg.dtmcs_nxt(16) <= dmi_ctrl.dmireset

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.err
signals.functionality: Flags an error when a new DMI request is issued while the controller is busy; it is cleared by resets and can be reflected into the DMI DR and DTMCS reporting.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.err cleared when resets set, set to '1' when busy and dr_trigger.valid and tap_reg.ireg = addr_dmi_c in dmi_controller; tap_reg.dmi_nxt and dtmcs_nxt include err

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.rdata
signals.functionality: Captures the data field from dmi_rsp_i when responses arrive and supplies it into tap_reg.dmi_nxt so read results can be presented in the DMI DR. It is updated while a transaction is active.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.rdata <= dmi_rsp_i.data in dmi_controller; tap_reg.dmi_nxt includes dmi_ctrl.rdata

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.wdata
signals.functionality: Holds the 32-bit write data for DMI requests; it is loaded from tap_reg.dmi when a write is triggered and exported via dmi_req_o.data to the external target.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.wdata <= tap_reg.dmi(33 downto 02) when starting transaction; dmi_req_o.data <= dmi_ctrl.wdata

signals.name: dmi_ctrl.addr
signals.functionality: Holds the 7-bit address for the current DMI transaction. It is loaded from the DMI DR when a request is triggered and is exported to the external target via dmi_req_o.addr.
signals.evidence: dmi_ctrl.addr <= tap_reg.dmi(40 downto 34) when starting transaction; dmi_req_o.addr <= dmi_ctrl.addr
